dlg.bark_boss_phase_armand_1.1: Is that the best you have, hunter?
dlg.bark_boss_phase_armand_2.1: My subjects applaud. They applaud any victor.
dlg.bark_boss_phase_armand_3.1: He is still smiling. That bothers me more than the blows.
dlg.bark_boss_phase_invisible_woman_1.1: She's faster now. The strikes still warn before landing.
dlg.bark_boss_phase_invisible_woman_2.1: Closer to the end. She knows it too.
dlg.bark_boss_phase_labyrinth_keeper_2.1: He's closing in. I read the marks on the floor.
dlg.bark_boss_phase_silver_dragonkin_1.1: Silver and rage. He is only starting to get angry.
dlg.bark_boss_phase_silver_dragonkin_2.1: Breathe, Virgil. Tail, claws, spit. One at a time.
dlg.bark_low_health_2.1: Hold on, hunter. I haven't finished the chapter.
dlg.bark_room_cleared_castle.1: Silence bought with iron. Costly, but silence.
dlg.bark_room_cleared_dungeons.1: Only the chains swaying. For now.
dlg.bark_room_cleared_garden.1: The roses close, slowly. Like something waiting.
dlg.bark_room_enter_1.1: Cold stone. The smell of iron. Nothing new.
dlg.bark_room_enter_castle.1: Halls too wide for so little life.
dlg.bark_room_enter_castle_2.1: Rugs without dust. Someone still tends this place.
dlg.bark_room_enter_castle_3.1: Every step brings me closer to him.
dlg.bark_room_enter_dungeons_1.1: Open cells. Whoever was in here didn't leave by choice.
dlg.bark_room_enter_dungeons_2.1: Chains still warm. Someone was taken not long ago.
dlg.bark_room_enter_garden.1: Roses watered with blood. Someone took care.
dlg.bark_room_enter_garden_2.1: Too much fog. Something is breathing inside it.
dlg.bark_room_enter_garden_3.1: The thorns move when I look away.
dlg.bark_room_enter_odalric_castle.1: The upper wing. I only ever saw it in a report. Describe it to me later.
dlg.bark_room_enter_odalric_dungeons.1: The dungeons. In my book: "hospitality, see also punishment".
dlg.boss_post_armand.1: A man. I was a man, before I became a name.
dlg.boss_post_armand.2: Rest. Or whatever is left of you.
dlg.boss_post_armand.3: It's over. Then why does the blood still sing?
dlg.boss_post_invisible_woman.1: No body. Just the air settling back into place.
dlg.boss_post_invisible_woman.2: Defeated. I don't know if that means finished.
dlg.boss_post_labyrinth_keeper.1: The walls stopped. Even a labyrinth knows when it has lost.
dlg.boss_post_labyrinth_keeper.2: The Keeper has fallen. What remains is to learn what he truly guarded.
dlg.boss_post_silver_dragonkin.1: Cold silver on the floor. He never asked to guard these stairs.
dlg.boss_post_silver_dragonkin.2: One room remains, Virgil. After it, the chapter I both dread and long to write.
dlg.boss_pre_armand.1: Virgil. My dungeons, my garden, my whole castle. And you still call it fleeing.
dlg.boss_pre_armand.2: I didn't come for you. I came for what you left in my blood.
dlg.boss_pre_armand.3: It's the same thing. The curse is only my name, spoken from within.
dlg.boss_pre_armand.5: Try. My subjects do love a spectacle.
dlg.boss_pre_generic.1: {3} awaits. Time to close this floor.
dlg.boss_pre_invisible_woman.1: Still air, lit candles and no one in sight. Show yourself.
dlg.boss_pre_invisible_woman.2: I never left, hunter. You just didn't know how to look.
dlg.boss_pre_invisible_woman.3: Armand left a guard at the door. How original.
dlg.boss_pre_invisible_woman.4: Armand left a prisoner. Today she gets to take it out on someone.
dlg.boss_pre_invisible_woman.5: Then take it out. I'm in a hurry.
dlg.boss_pre_invisible_woman.6: Watch the floor, child of the night. It's the only courtesy I offer.
dlg.boss_pre_invisible_woman_again_1.1: Back again. Armand's blood won't let you rest, will it?
dlg.boss_pre_invisible_woman_again_2.1: I watched you from the first door. You still haven't learned to look.
dlg.boss_pre_invisible_woman_again_2.2: I learned to read the floor. That's enough.
dlg.boss_pre_labyrinth_keeper.1: The walls won't hold still. This isn't a corridor, it's a mouth.
dlg.boss_pre_labyrinth_keeper.2: The Keeper of the Labyrinth changes the path and charges for every distraction. Read the marks on the floor: everything here warns before it wounds.
dlg.boss_pre_silver_dragonkin.1: Heat. The smell of molten metal. Armand guards the stairs with a dragon.
dlg.boss_pre_silver_dragonkin.2: Claws, tail, spit, a whole requiem. A large repertoire, and every piece warns before it lands.
dlg.first_hub_arrival.1: So you're the hunter who fled Armand. Welcome to the Crow's Nest.
dlg.first_hub_arrival.2: "Fled" is a generous word. I can still feel the curse in my blood.
dlg.first_hub_arrival.3: Everyone does. The Blood Fountain ahead trades the Ichor you bring back for strength. Use it.
dlg.first_hub_arrival.4: I'll stay here with my book. Someone has to write how this ends.
dlg.first_hub_arrival.curt_reply.1: Good. Guides talk too much. I only write.
dlg.first_hub_arrival.who_reply.1: Odalric, the Chronicler. I served in Armand's court. Now I record each of your attempts in this book.
dlg.first_hub_arrival.who_reply.2: A pact of ink bound me to this nest. It lets me go only at the last chapter.
dlg.odalric_after_first_boss.1: Virgil. The Invisible Warden has fallen. I wrote "defeated", not "dead". There is a difference.
dlg.odalric_after_first_boss.2: The archives tie a moon and a cat to that post. I never knew why.
dlg.odalric_after_first_boss.3: The sealed beds in the east have been restless since. Perhaps it's only the wind.
dlg.odalric_after_second_boss.1: The Keeper of the Labyrinth has fallen. Noted, but the maze was never the point. What it enclosed was.
dlg.odalric_after_second_boss.2: From the east, by the sealed beds, I now hear a rhythm against the stone. Perhaps it's only the wind. Perhaps.
dlg.odalric_after_second_boss.3: Carry on, Virgil. The book still has pages.
dlg.odalric_after_third_boss.1: A silver dragon, and you're still standing. I've started writing your name in larger letters.
dlg.odalric_after_third_boss.2: Only the throne remains. Armand knows you're coming, and Armand hates not being the surprise.
dlg.odalric_after_third_boss.3: The sealed beds let a thread of light through. I won't say what I saw. Not yet.
dlg.odalric_after_victory.1: Armand has fallen, and the pact of ink still binds me to this nest.
dlg.odalric_after_victory.2: Either I wrote the last chapter wrong, or it wasn't the last.
dlg.odalric_after_victory.3: Either way, blank pages remain. I'm keeping them for you.
dlg.odalric_armand_rumor.1: They say Armand was once a man. The curse, however, is older than he is.
dlg.odalric_armand_rumor.2: The archives I kept burned the night he crowned himself.
dlg.odalric_armand_rumor.3: Rumors are what remain. I write them all down. I sift later.
dlg.odalric_bench_book.1: That book on the bench is about weapons. Your sword has a chapter of its own.
dlg.odalric_bench_book.2: Short, but bloody. Just how I like it.
dlg.odalric_death_again.1: Another line in the book. My handwriting no longer pretends to be surprised.
dlg.odalric_death_again.2: Spend what you brought at the Blood Fountain and go back. It's what you do best.
dlg.odalric_death_by_armand.1: Armand again. I served at his table for years: he only tires of those who stop trying.
dlg.odalric_death_by_armand.2: Tell me what you saw up there. I'll write it down, you tend the wounds. We split the labor.
dlg.odalric_death_by_boss1.1: You fell before the Invisible Warden. Her strikes give warning before they land. Watch the floor.
dlg.odalric_death_by_boss1.2: I noted it as "too soon". There is time to revise the chapter.
dlg.odalric_first_death.1: Your first time? Noted. Blood doesn't forget, hunter. Neither does the book.
dlg.odalric_first_death.2: But you came back. That's more than many of my chapters managed.
dlg.odalric_lineages_a.1: Dracul commands. It takes another's life and makes it its own, blow by blow.
dlg.odalric_lineages_a.2: Bathory prefers pools of blood and sacrifice. It heals whoever pays the price.
dlg.odalric_lineages_a.3: Myself, I prefer whichever one lives long enough to be written down.
dlg.odalric_lineages_b.1: Karnstein seduces. Agility and charm: the enemy fights for you, or doesn't fight at all.
dlg.odalric_lineages_b.2: Orlok sickens. Pestilence, control, and a risk that always charges interest.
dlg.odalric_lineages_b.3: The Stirps blend two of these lineages. Rare, and almost never kind.
dlg.odalric_many_deaths.1: {1} deaths in the book. I've started numbering them.
dlg.odalric_many_runs.1: {0} attempts recorded. My inkwell is nearly dry.
dlg.odalric_many_runs.2: Keep at it. I prefer a long story to a pretty one.
dlg.odalric_name_close.1: You asked my name on the first day. In the court they called me "the archive".
dlg.odalric_name_close.2: Nobody asked. An archive has no name, only a shelf.
dlg.odalric_name_close.3: Thank you, Virgil. It's noted in small letters, so as not to ruin my reputation.
dlg.odalric_name_curt.1: On the first day you turned down guides. Noted, and respected.
dlg.odalric_name_curt.2: But a chronicler without a reader writes poorly. Go on without a guide; just don't pretend you can't hear me.
dlg.odalric_return_abandoned.1: Gave up midway? I noted a retreat. Those who retreat live to write.
dlg.odalric_return_victory.1: You reached the end of the castle. My last chapter, or your first.
dlg.odalric_return_victory.2: Come. I want to hear everything, then pretend I always knew.
dlg.speaker.armand.name: Lord Armand
dlg.speaker.invisible_woman.name: Invisible Warden
dlg.speaker.odalric.name: Odalric
dlg.speaker.virgil.name: Virgil
